name: @hafley66/docs-kit
description: The documentation site apparatus every package in this workspace shares: the live demo panel, the in-view runner, the receipts renderer, the doc lint, and the API reference generator.
//: vite, vitepress, vue, playwright and @hafley66/signals are peers rather than dependencies on purpose. A second copy of any of the first four in this package's own node_modules is a second Vue app instance, or a second @vitest/browser. @hafley66/signals is a peer because `packages/signals` consumes this package, and a dependency edge back would be a cycle.
